source: Graaf et al. (1986,1988) Chem. Eng. Sci.; Vanden Bussche & Froment (1996) J. Catal. 161, 1-10
description: Cu/ZnO/Al2O3 low-pressure methanol synthesis CSTR with Vanden Bussche-Froment LHHW kinetics (CO2 hydrogenation + RWGS), equilibrium-limited conversion and exothermic energy balance with cooling.

UA.note: Overall heat transfer coeff x area (boiling-water cooled tubes)

m_thermal.note: Thermal mass of reactor tubes + catalyst

P_total.note: Total pressure (VB&F base case; industrial 50-100 bar)

cp_gas.note: Average molar heat capacity of syngas mixture

feed_fractions.note: VB&F (1996) representative H2-rich syngas feed; H2/(2CO2+3CO)~stoich

dH_RWGS.note: CO2 + H2 -> CO + H2O, dH298 = +41.2 kJ/mol (endothermic RWGS)

kinetics.unit: A: mol/(kg_cat.s.bar) or bar^-n ; E: J/mol (in A*exp(E/RT))
kinetics.note: Vanden Bussche & Froment (1996) J.Catal.161 Table 2 LHHW rate/adsorption constants, written as A*exp(E/RT). k1=MeOH rate const, k2=RWGS rate const, Ka=sqrt(K_H2), Kb=K_H2O, Kc=K_H2O/K_H2.
